importantFindings: Helmsman 31 is explicitly an updated Camano 31 design; B-Atlas records lineage without merging the distinct brands/models.
Helmsman 43E and 46 legacy aft-cabin assumptions were incorrect; their accommodation is not a conventional aft-cabin arrangement.
Great Harbour N-series is explicitly the second generation of Great Harbour full-displacement trawlers.
Greenline 33 and 39 propulsion/energy source can be diesel, hybrid or electric; B-Atlas avoids forcing one fuel code.
North Pacific 38 Sedan has strong contemporary published specifications; North Pacific 28 is retained more conservatively because the model-specific factory page is unavailable.
Nimbus 365 supports single and twin engine alternatives; engine count is therefore configuration-specific.
FJORD 36/40 Open and Cruiser records are correctly treated as deep-V/planing modern cruisers with IPS/pod lineage where documented.
Sea Sport 2400 XL and Explorer are outboard deep-V pilothouse boats and support single or twin outboard configurations.
Sea Sport 27 remains flagged for a dedicated identity split review because Seamaster, Navigator and Pilot are currently combined in one B-Atlas record.
